name: 50294-videoprefill-gemma4-26ba4b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, no expert parallelism, one in-process vLLM engine, one node.
architecture: Gemma4ForConditionalGeneration (model_type gemma4), bf16, 51.6 GB across two safetensors shards, sparse-MoE text stack beside a vision tower, public and ungated under apache-2.0. Shapes are in the checkpoint's own config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=8, bound at 128 requests, warmup 10%, no cooldown, static seed 50294, safety_seconds 5400.
workload: One video plus 885 tokens of text per request, in text + video order, and 32 tokens out at temperature 0. The video is a guidellm `synthetic_video`: 32 frames, 640x360, 1 fps, mp4/h264, gradient content. The declared 885 counts text tokens only; with the vision tokens the prompt is roughly 10k.
purpose: A video question-answering assistant handling short-clip-plus-text prompts with brief replies, eight concurrent users, one GPU.
launch:
# A vision-enabled serving deployment of a Gemma-4 multimodal checkpoint, run at engine
# defaults except for the keys below.

model: google/gemma-4-26B-A4B-it

# MUST STAY ON ONE LINE, as JSON: an indented block mapping is skipped by the config reader and
# the key is dropped at rc=0.
attention-config: {"flash_attn_version": 4}

# MUST STAY ON ONE LINE: the engine's config reader takes this file line by line and skips
# indented ones, so a block mapping here drops the key silently at rc=0.
limit-mm-per-prompt: {"image": 0, "video": 1}

max-model-len: 16384

tensor-parallel-size: 1
